title: App-wide overlays, dialogs and system screens (old look) - part 1 of 3 (G-001..G-014; mainly main.dart, onboarding_overlays.dart, offline_guard.dart)

guards.step_title: App-wide overlays, dialogs and system screens (old look)
guards.situation: On the very first start the intro animation covers the whole app and swallows every touch on the screens below it; it is shown only once per installation.
guards.old_where: main.dart:395-415 (_checkOnboarding reads mg_intro_shown, _onIntroDone writes it); core/widgets/moto_fx.dart:459-478 (_finish runs onDone once), :497-499 (opaque GestureDetector, tap = skip)
guards.customer_sees: Dark full-screen logo animation with a passing motorbike for about 2.4 s; a tap anywhere ends it.
v2_where: main.dart:524-529 (v2On ? IntroV2(onDone: _onIntroDone) : MotoIntroOverlay); features/shell/v2/intro_v2.dart:50-55 (_finish once), :81-83 (opaque GestureDetector), :108-113 (visible 'Přeskočit' pill)
guards.verdict_evidence: Both looks use the same _showIntro flag and the same _onIntroDone callback that writes mg_intro_shown (main.dart:411-415). IntroV2 is equally opaque and ends exactly once; it adds a visible skip pill, so the customer is told at least as clearly. Under reduced motion it holds the end frame 600 ms then finishes (intro_v2.dart:39-41).

guards.step_title: App-wide overlays, dialogs and system screens (old look)
guards.surface: S-014 Offline full-screen overlay / S-168..S-177 (all shop screens) / Whole app (overlay)
guards.situation: When the phone loses connection (or the app starts without one), a full-screen 'you are offline' overlay is placed above every screen and dialog route present at that moment, so the customer cannot keep tapping through screens that would fail.
old_where: core/offline_guard.dart:66-87 (startWatching), :120-133 (_showOverlay inserts into root navigator overlay), :209-359 (_OfflineOverlay); main.dart:303-313
lib/main.dart:264 and :303-308 (OfflineGuard.startWatching on the app root, not per look)
guards.customer_sees: Black page with 📡, 'Nejsi připojený k internetu' heading, explanation, 'Zkusit znovu' and 'Pokračovat bez internetu' buttons, plus emergency call links.
v2_where: core/offline_guard.dart:268-275 (MgV2.on -> OfflineViewV2 with the same _checking/_stillOffline state and the same onRetry/onContinue); features/shell/v2/offline_view_v2.dart:37-66
Same root code for both looks (main.dart:264-308); back belongs to the overlay (lib/core/widgets/mg_back.dart MgBackGuard._onBack checks OfflineGuard.overlayVisible)
guards.verdict_evidence: The overlay entry, its trigger and its callbacks are one code path; only the drawing differs. v2 (MgStateScreen with wifi-off icon, title and a 'what still works' list) is at least as clear. CHANGED SINCE 4.1.3 IN BOTH LOOKS: in 70a94933 offline_guard.dart _OfflineOverlay had only 'Zkusit znovu' and no way past; this branch added 'Pokračovat bez internetu', system back = continue, and emergency calls (comment offline_guard.dart:18-21, owner request 2026-10-16). This is not a v2 difference, but it is a softer block than the released app.

merged_situations.situation: The device is offline; the app-wide offline overlay blocks the screen until the connection returns.
Without connection a full-screen overlay explains it and offers Retry, "Pokračovat bez internetu", call MotoGo24 and 112; after continuing, a thin strip stays on top.
